bio.text: Roland Lemar was first elected in 2010 to represent the 96th Assembly District in New Haven and is now in his seventh term.
He is House Chair of the General Law Committee and a member of the Finance, Revenue and Bonding and Planning and Development Committees.
Lemar grew up in Rhode Island, attended the University of Massachusetts at Amherst, and lives in New Haven's East Rock neighborhood.
Before becoming a state representative he served on New Haven's Board of Aldermen, chairing its Legislation Committee, and on the City Plan Commission.
